title: 瑞银李慧：AI生态中，哪里盈利更可靠？
speaker: Eva Lee

segments.en: So where are you seeing in terms of an earnings perspective, the more momentum when it comes to generating revenues and profits within the AI ecosystem?
segments.zh: 从盈利角度看，AI生态中哪里在产生收入和利润方面更有动能？

segments.en: This is how I look at it. Now we have so many models to choose from, and I don't know which one it's going to win. I don't know how quickly the monetization will come. So the easier
segments.zh: 我是这样看的。现在有这么多模型可选，我不知道哪个会胜出，也不知道变现多快到来。所以更容易的

segments.en: bet, you need to pay for your chips, you need to pay your advanced packaging, optical, and everything. So that is more reliable earnings driver for me, at least at this stage.
segments.zh: 押注是，你需要为芯片付费，为先进封装、光学等付费。这对我来说是更可靠的盈利驱动力，至少现阶段如此。
